statement: SemRisk shall distinguish the managed risk phenomenon/pattern from every information artifact that describes or records it.
rationale: This is the dominant Paper-1 semantic gap and prevents operational records from becoming ontology truth.
evidence_source_ids: REC-001; REC-003; NIST 8286; COVER; RisKG; RiskHub; SRC-OP-001
required_distinctions_relations: Risk; Risk Register Entry; Risk Register; Scenario Description; refers-to/records-about
expected_capability: Represent one risk-related phenomenon independently from one or more descriptions/register entries.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish Risk Scenario, Scenario Description and realized Risk Event/Incident.
rationale: Sources overload scenario as possibility, narrative and occurrence; Paper 1 explicitly claims this separation.
required_distinctions_relations: possible/hypothesized scenario; information artifact; realized occurrence
expected_capability: Represent and query the three identities without forcing equivalence.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish Risk Assessment Activity from Risk Assessment Result.
rationale: Operational fields encode results while methods/ontologies distinguish process and output.
evidence_source_ids: REC-004; PA-006; IOF Biopharma; RISKMAN; SRC-OP-001
required_distinctions_relations: activity; result; method; time; subject; evidence
expected_capability: Represent who/what assessed, with which method/evidence/time, and what result was produced.

statement: SemRisk shall treat inherent and residual risk labels as assessment-context/result semantics by default, not separate timeless risks.
rationale: Avoids duplicating the same underlying risk whenever treatment context changes.
evidence_source_ids: REC-005; SRC-OP-001; IOF Biopharma; NIST lifecycle; UL-T010/T011
required_distinctions_relations: underlying risk identity; pre/post-treatment context; assessment result
expected_capability: Compare inherent and residual results for the same risk and different contexts/times.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish Risk State from Workflow State of a record/process.
rationale: Closing a ticket or completing an analysis must not imply that the real-world risk ceased.
evidence_source_ids: REC-006; NIST 8286A; SRC-OP-001; UL-T014/T015
required_distinctions_relations: risk-relevant state; register/workflow state; temporal validity
expected_capability: Represent independent state dimensions and historical transitions.

statement: SemRisk shall represent Risk Owner as a context-dependent role/responsibility relation borne by an actor, not as an organization/person type.
rationale: Operational sources mix persons, units and role labels.
evidence_source_ids: REC-007; NIST RDR; GRC; UL-T016/T017
required_distinctions_relations: actor; role; responsibility/accountability; assignment
expected_capability: Identify accountable actors and their role/assignment without redefining actor taxonomy.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish treatment strategy, treatment plan, treatment activity and control mechanism.
rationale: Sources overload control/mitigation/response into one label.
required_distinctions_relations: strategy; plan; activity; mechanism/control; treated risk
expected_capability: Represent how a decision is planned/executed and what persistent mechanism is used.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish Evidence Item, Observation Activity/Result, Signal and Provenance while allowing contextual evidential roles.
rationale: Reassessment and claim traceability require identity and lineage separation.
evidence_source_ids: REC-009; OpenPVSignal; PH-004/005; UL-T032/T033/T034/T035/T036
required_distinctions_relations: evidence artifact; observation; result; signal; provenance/derivation
expected_capability: Trace an assessment/assertion to evidence, observation results, source/version and derivation.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish causal, associative/dependency and enabling/trigger relations in source→condition→trigger→event→consequence chains.
rationale: Operational narratives and empirical data differ in causal strength.
required_distinctions_relations: risk source; predisposing condition; trigger; event; consequence; causation; association
expected_capability: Represent a risk chain without upgrading association/dependency evidence to causation.

statement: SemRisk shall link risk semantics to externally owned objectives, capabilities, processes and controls without redefining them as Risk subclasses.
rationale: Enterprise operationalization is a supporting contribution and must respect semantic ownership.
evidence_source_ids: REC-013; GRC; PA-009; RiskHub; UL-T045 relation family
required_distinctions_relations: risk concerns/affects objective/capability/process; external ownership
expected_capability: Navigate from a risk to affected enterprise context and back through governed relations.

statement: SemRisk shall map the governed Jira-style spreadsheet/register schema without class-per-column/table/enum translation.
rationale: Operational evidence is design input, not ontology truth.
required_distinctions_relations: field→concept/relation/result/state mapping; unmapped/deferred field status
expected_capability: Produce explicit mapping where one field may map to relation/result/profile/data artifact rather than a class.

statement: SemRisk shall preserve assessment method, time, context, evidence and confidence/uncertainty where modeled.
rationale: Assessment results are context-dependent and must remain auditable across reassessment.
evidence_source_ids: SRC-OP-001; NIST 8286; PA-015; REC-004/009; UL assessment/evidence terms
required_distinctions_relations: assessment method/time/context/evidence/confidence; reassessment history
expected_capability: Retrieve why, when and under what method/evidence a result exists and compare historical results.

statement: SemRisk shall keep likelihood, probability, frequency, impact severity and ordinal scales method-specific unless a stronger semantic equivalence is established.
rationale: Method values must not inflate the Core.
evidence_source_ids: REC-011; IEC 31010; NIST; Jira scales; ULC-013/014
required_distinctions_relations: generic assessment-result semantics vs method-specific scale/value
expected_capability: Support multiple assessment methods/scales without treating labels as universal subclasses.

statement: SemRisk shall federate the bounded Pharma case with the frozen CM-PharmE v1.0.0 baseline while preserving external semantic ownership.
rationale: Generic Pharma ontology/entity ownership is prior art; SemRisk contribution is governed federation.
evidence_source_ids: REC-014; DEP-003; CM-PharmE v1.0.0; PH-009/011; IOF Biopharma
required_distinctions_relations: SemRisk risk pattern ↔ external Pharma entity mappings; ownership; profile extensions
expected_capability: Represent Pharma risk relevance using CM-PharmE entities without minting competing Core copies.

statement: SemRisk shall distinguish reusable Core semantics from Pharma-specific extensions and record explicit unmapped/context-dependent semantics.
rationale: SR-C3 is bounded federation/transfer, not universal Pharma validity.
evidence_source_ids: G1 source delta; Pharma corpus; CM-PharmE; DS-003/004
required_distinctions_relations: Core/profile boundary; mapping status; unmapped/context-dependent concepts
expected_capability: For a Pharma case element, determine whether it is Core, external-owner mapping, profile extension or unmapped/deferred.

statement: SemRisk shall support a bounded comparison of which Core distinctions hold in both operational-register and Pharma evidence without claiming universal transferability.
rationale: Transfer claim is conditional and must expose failures/limitations.
evidence_source_ids: SR-CL06; G1 role policy; DS-003/004; SRC-OP-001
required_distinctions_relations: cross-context semantic capability; failure/unmapped evidence
expected_capability: Report matched, partially matched and failed transfer cases with explicit denominator and evidence roles.

statement: SemRisk shall make source→candidate→semantic decision→formal artifact→CQ/evaluation→claim traceability reconstructable.
rationale: Paper credibility and reproducibility require governed provenance rather than opaque modeling.
evidence_source_ids: G1 artifacts; evidence vocabulary; claim register; #41
required_distinctions_relations: source refs; decision refs; artifact version; CQ/claim links
expected_capability: Reconstruct why a release-critical semantic commitment exists and which evidence/tests support it.

statement: SemRisk shall explicitly reject or isolate common anti-concepts and implementation artifacts instead of silently promoting them to ontology truth.
rationale: Negative controls are needed to protect the semantic contribution.
evidence_source_ids: ANTI-001..022; G1 conflicts; #19 audit
required_distinctions_relations: DB table/field; UI status; score; ticket; synthetic data; reasoner pass; taxonomy value
expected_capability: Answer negative CQs by showing why common implementation artifacts do not imply domain identity/equivalence.

statement: SemRisk shall preserve the possibility of multiple records, descriptions, assessments and evidence items referring to the same underlying risk context over time.
rationale: Operational history and reassessment should not require duplicating the underlying risk by default.
evidence_source_ids: NIST 8286/RDR; Jira history; REC-001/003/004/006/009
required_distinctions_relations: one risk↔many records/descriptions/assessments/evidence; temporal validity
expected_capability: Represent historical reassessment and multiple representations without identity collapse.

statement: SemRisk shall keep broad Health, pharmacovigilance runtime integration, Newsium/Commentium and dynamic forecasting outside the Paper-1 required semantic contract.
rationale: The paper boundary is deliberately narrow and must not expand during modeling.
evidence_source_ids: Research contract nonclaims; G1 C5; #4/#6/#36/#57
required_distinctions_relations: scope boundary; deferred capabilities
expected_capability: Keep related CQs visible as deferred without using them to block Paper-1 G2.
